short: Prove the count identity for the alternate host

lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.characterSumData.colour_balance
lean.plain: Prove the count identity for the alternate host
lean.note: Lean expands the weighted prime-power count by character orthogonality and isolates the trivial and quadratic character contributions to the main term. This proof of the balance identity for hosts ramified only among three specified primes is outside the final dependency cone.
